description: List existing FLUF products on one or more marketplaces. Not always synchronous: channels completed by the seller's own browser extension (e.g. Vinted, Facebook) return `queued` and go live minutes later. The response has a `status` per channel. Repeats of the same (product, channel) pair within 30s are ignored as accidental double-submits.

targets.description: Channels to list on. Use the ids from list_channels. To target a specific account when the seller has several on one channel, append the connection id: 'depop:208'.

vids.description: Product handles to crosslist, taken verbatim from the `vid` field of list_products (e.g. 'shopify_123456_0'). Not a bare numeric id.

name: crosslist
